basic_details.job_title: NEC Superintending Engineer Recruitment 2027 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of the receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Master Degree or Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute; twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads; holding an analogous post on a regular basis, or five years regular service in level-12.
qualification.details: Qualification: Master Degree or Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute; twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads Experience: Twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads; and holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or Department, or five years service after regular appointment in level-12 in the pay matrix (Rs.78800-209200) or equivalent Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of the receipt of applications) | Other conditions: | Candidates who apply cannot withdraw their candidature later

how_to_apply: Download the Application Form/Curriculum Vitae Proforma (Annexure-II) and other details from the NEC website https://necouncil.gov.in.
Complete and sign Annexure-II; it must be countersigned and sealed by the Cadre/Appointing authority.
Attach the enclosures listed in the notice.

Cadre authorities/Heads of Departments forward the application so that it reaches the Director (Admn.), NEC Secretariat, Nongrim Hill, Shillong: 793003, within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in the Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 12 January 2027.
important_instructions: Annexure-II item 17: officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption; candidates of non-Government organizations are eligible only for Short Term Contract Phone number given in the notice: 0364-2522647

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 12 January 2027 Vacancies: 1 How to apply: Offline, by post or in person as the notification says Pay: Level-13 (Rs.123100-215900) Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of the receipt of applications) Place: Shillong

content_sections.heading: NEC Superintending Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2027 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.north_eastern_council_secretariat_nec_sh: Master Degree or Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute; twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads; holding an analogous post on a regular basis, or five years regular service in level-12.
Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of the receipt of applications)
Director (Admn.), NEC Secretariat, Nongrim Hill, Shillong: 793003

content_sections.heading: NEC Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. ADMN-12012(11)/1/2026-ADMN gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NEC notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master Degree or Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute; twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads Experience: Twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads; and holding an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or Department, or five years service after regular appointment in level-12 in the pay matrix (Rs.78800-209200) or equivalent Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on closing date of the receipt of applications) Other conditions: Candidates who apply cannot withdraw their candidature later

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for NEC Recruitment 2027
content_sections.text: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation (including short term contract) for a period of 2 (two) years Pay and other terms regulated by DOPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time

content_sections.heading: How Will NEC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae supported by documents is assessed by the Selection Committee The Curriculum Vitae duly supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in Annexure-II, completed, signed, countersigned and sealed by the Cadre/Appointing authority Attested copies of ACRs for the last 5 years, attested on each page with seal by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or equivalent Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance Major or minor penalty certificate for the last 10 years of service Cadre clearance certificate Certificate that the particulars have been verified and found correct as per service records Self-attested copy of certificates of educational qualifications

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Annexure-II item 17: officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption; candidates of non-Government organizations are eligible only for Short Term Contract Phone number given in the notice: 0364-2522647

content_sections.heading: NEC Superintending Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2027 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NEC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 12 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NEC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Superintending Engineer (Civil).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NEC Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Curriculum Vitae Proforma) in the notice; also to be downloaded from the NEC website https://necouncil.gov.in) and send it to Director (Admn.), NEC Secretariat, Nongrim Hill, Shillong: 793003, by post, to reach by 12 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on closing date of the receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master Degree or Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute; twelve years experience in execution or construction of civil works including hill roads; holding an analogous post on a regular basis, or five years regular service in level-12.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who apply cannot withdraw their candidature later.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Curriculum Vitae supported by documents is assessed by the Selection Committee. The Curriculum Vitae duly supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short term contract) for a period of 2 (two) years. Pay and other terms regulated by DOPT OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 as amended from time to time.
